title: Proper morphisms descend along fpqc coverings
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Write $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ for the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If every $f_i$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $f$ is proper.

proof.text: The source-library instance isProper_descendsAlong_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasiCompact supplies descent of properness along a surjective flat quasi-compact morphism. Mathlib supplies Zariski locality on the target and stability under base change for IsProper.

The covering presieve generates an fpqc covering sieve by Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck. For every i, take the canonical pullback square with first projection pullback.fst f (g i) and second projection pullback.snd f (g i); its pullback witness is IsPullback.of_hasPullback.

Apply the already proved generic covering-family descent theorem Scheme.of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology with P = IsProper to these squares and the assumed proper second projections. This gives IsProper f, including arbitrary index universes and the empty covering of the empty base.
